ModMetaData.name: Faction Relation Seeder (Community)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Data-driven opening faction-relationship matrix. Author a RelationSeedDef in XML — pairs of faction defNames with a target goodwill — and the mod applies it once when a NEW game starts. After that it never touches relations again, leaving the world free to evolve (Rim War, etc.).

Use it to set the political geometry of a themed start: who begins allied, who begins at war. Factions referenced by defName are resolved softly at runtime — any faction not present (mod not installed / not spawned) is skipped, never an error.

No Harmony (native WorldComponent.FinalizeInit hook). No hard dependencies. Existing saves are left untouched; seeding fires only on brand-new games.
